<ic>To expand the existing law regarding auras on the Senate to include the Civil Service Hub. The Citizens granted a vote would be the Magistrates and Civil Servants <br><br>''Proposed by Astolat, seconded by Bastion.''</ic>

===Overview===
* Extend the law prohibiting [[auras_illegal_in_the_Senate|auras in the senate]].

===Date===
* Winter 378YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* At the time, a member of the [[Synod]] indicated an intention to discuss raising a [[veto]]. In the end they did not do so, and the law came into effect after the first Senate session at the Spring Equinox event.
